news.title: Archiving your academic journey: Preserving coursework and program artifacts
news.summary_en: Nearly every week, I get queries from potential students about obtaining credit for previous coursework towards a degree or licensure. Often, they are unable to provide detailed records of their previous academic work beyond the transcript.

news.title: How we recovered student trust after big Wi-Fi challenges
news.summary_en: Every day I come to work at Gettysburg College wearing a college-branded cap that I bought with a $25 gift card, presented to me by the Student Senate for leading an effort to improve student access to the campus Wi-Fi.
